name: Millet Soup Mix
shortDescription: Quick-cook soup mix with ragi, foxtail millet and lentils.
ingredients: Ragi, foxtail millet, moong dal, dried vegetables, rock salt, spices
howToUse: Mix the soup mix into hot water, stir and cook until thick. Follow the pack instructions.

name: Tomato Vegetable Soup Mix
shortDescription: Light tomato soup mix with dried vegetables and herbs.
ingredients: Tomato powder, carrot, beans, onion, garlic, black pepper, rock salt
howToUse: Stir into hot water and simmer for a few minutes. Follow the pack instructions.

name: Oats and Nut Muesli
shortDescription: No added sugar muesli with oats, almonds and pumpkin seeds.
ingredients: Rolled oats, almonds, pumpkin seeds, flax seeds, cinnamon
howToUse: Serve with milk or curd. Add fresh fruit if you like.

name: Jowar Dosa Mix
shortDescription: Ready dosa mix made with jowar and urad dal.
ingredients: Jowar flour, urad dal, rice flour, fenugreek, salt
howToUse: Mix with water to a pouring batter, rest as per the pack, then cook on a hot pan.

name: Besan Chilla Mix
shortDescription: Savoury chilla mix with besan, spices and dried herbs.
ingredients: Besan, rice flour, cumin, turmeric, ajwain, coriander leaves, salt
howToUse: Mix with water to a smooth batter and cook on a lightly oiled pan.

name: Ragi Cookies
shortDescription: Crisp ragi cookies lightly sweetened with dates.
ingredients: Ragi flour, whole wheat flour, dates, ghee, cardamom
howToUse: Ready to eat. Store in an airtight box.

name: Roasted Makhana, Pepper
shortDescription: Light, crunchy fox nuts roasted with black pepper.
ingredients: Makhana, olive oil, black pepper, rock salt
howToUse: Ready to eat. Store in an airtight box.

name: Roasted Chana Masala
shortDescription: Crunchy roasted chickpeas with a mild masala.
howToUse: Ready to eat. Good for carrying to work or night shifts.

name: Roasted Chana
shortDescription: Crunchy roasted chickpeas with a pinch of salt.
howToUse: Ready to eat. Store in an airtight box.

name: Multigrain Atta
shortDescription: Stone-ground blend of wheat, jowar, ragi and chana.
ingredients: Whole wheat, jowar, ragi, bengal gram
howToUse: Use like regular atta for rotis and parathas.

name: Ragi Flour
shortDescription: Fine stone-ground ragi flour for rotis, porridge and dosa.
howToUse: Use for rotis, dosa or porridge. Follow the pack instructions.

name: Mixed Seeds, Lightly Roasted
shortDescription: Pumpkin, sunflower and flax seeds, dry roasted with a pinch of salt.
ingredients: Pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, flax seeds, rock salt
howToUse: Ready to eat. Sprinkle on salads or curd, or eat as a snack.

name: Diwali Special Snack Hamper
shortDescription: Gift hamper of four snack packs: Ragi Cookies, Roasted Makhana (Pepper), Mixed Seeds and Roasted Chana Masala.
ingredients: Ragi Cookies: ragi flour, whole wheat flour, dates, ghee, cardamom. Roasted Makhana: makhana, olive oil, black pepper, rock salt. Mixed Seeds: pumpkin seeds, sunflower seeds, flax seeds, rock salt. Roasted Chana Masala: roasted chana, spices, rock salt.
howToUse: Ready to eat. Share with family or gift it. Store each pack airtight after opening.
